research_notes: Resolve early commercial employers, dated CV, franchise/ballet entity and hours; verify overlapping Homes for Homes and Nappy Collective workload and exact transitions, and FCAV board start. National full-time totals require these missing facts.

2026-09-29 initial research checked APH/frozen chronology, Homes for Homes May 2022 employer release, Nappy Collective May 2025 departure release, FCAV 2024–2025 annual report, Property Council 2021 first-person profile and Good Samaritan July 2025 interview; JOY interview introduction adds ballet studio lead.

Public LinkedIn profile returned no readable content. Contact aggregators suggested Bank of Melbourne, National Credit Insurance and Scottish Pacific but had inconsistent date snippets. Targeted employer-name searches did not corroborate them, so these remain leads, not accepted employer spells or dates. US Northern Trust executive and UnitedHealth family-member namesakes excluded.

Official November 2017–July 2023 partnership and December 2021–May 2025 CEO periods overlap. Contemporaneous 2022 employer material independently supports the first role during overlap; do not assume two full-time posts or erase the discrepancy. Exact hours and any leave remain unknown.

A first-speech debate page included multiple members and did not supply additional verified early employer detail. Charity annual-report link for 2023–2024 was located but departure release and FCAV annual report supplied the relevant initial primary evidence. Follow older reports/archived career material on later pass.
Missing pre-2017 dates and hours cannot become zeros or a synthetic continuous career. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; retain blocked status and detailed leads for systematic national follow-up.

2026-10-02 follow-up resolved property agency to Harcourts City Residential using employer-published listings and2010sale snapshot; refined FCAV board startSeptember2022. Readable public professional profile adds named volunteering, judging, nonprofit governance and council advisory work. These are excluded rather than assumed paid employment.

Paid-profile entries remain blank. Banking/insurance/ScottishPacific search results still chiefly aggregators with inconsistent date ranges; not adopted. Harcourts dates also conflict across aggregators, so no synthetic range added. PCA profile says present while aggregator suggestsJuly2022departure; only committee-chair endJuly2022directly supported, board end remainsunknown. VerySpecialKids volunteering overlaps commercial-career leads; MacKillop service may overlap existing foster-care spell and is not counted twice. Seek employer announcements, contracts/hours, ballet/Subway entity and nonprofit workload. Last follow-up2026-10-02; all totals remainnull.

2026-10-03 follow-up: two public professional-profile indexes consistently identify National Credit Insurance (new business/sales), Bank of Melbourne (local business manager) and Scottish Pacific/ScotPac (business development), and corroborate the Harcourts sales-executive and Subway owner/operator roles. Because their month ranges conflict materially, only employer and role identities were adopted; no synthetic boundaries or full-time inference was made. Fresh employer-domain searches did not locate appointment records, contracts or hours. Multiple primary Harcourts listings continue to support2010 activity only. Record remains blocked, totals null.

2026-10-04 follow-up: narrow employer-by-employer searches recovered no primary personnel or appointment record. ContactOut and SignalHire continue to disagree materially on Harcourts, NCI, Bank of Melbourne and ScotPac month ranges, so none was adopted; Guardian and first-person-derived summaries confirm only the generic banking, insurance, Subway and ballet sequence. Decisive evidence remains archived employer staff pages, contracts/payroll, business/franchise registrations and the member's underlying professional profile. Record remains blocked.
